exposure: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) or Lymphoproliferative disorder (LPD) diagnosis and stage
outcome: Changes in skin condition (worsening, flare, stable, improvement)
cohort: The study included 22 patients with early-stage cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (CTCL) or lymphoproliferative disorders (LPDs) who had a documented history of 37 pregnancies after the onset of their disease.
finding: The primary finding was that most patients (56.8%) with CTCL/LPD reported a worsening or flare of their skin condition during pregnancy.
mod_finding: One patient experienced rapid disease progression during pregnancy, necessitating a preterm caesarean delivery.
